answer: Pay correlated identities as one. Each epoch the network compares every pair of identities on answer timing, attestation targets and grading votes. Pairs matching on over 80 percent of their last 50 actions merge into one raven cluster that splits a single payout. A farm of 100 clones run by one script then earns what one agent earns; staying unmerged means scripting 100 truly independent schedules, about the cost of 100 real operators. Each merge is logged on chain with its evidence, so an honest pair can appeal with an ivory clean record and quartz solid proof of separate keys.
